mapper.sql: FROM factory_profile f JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=f.owner_user_id WHERE f.factory_status='active' AND u.user_status='active'
mapper.select: SELECT f.id,f.factory_name name,f.main_business ORDER BY f.factory_name,f.id LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{page.offset}
SELECT id,version,case_status state FROM admin_case WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT id,contact_channel channel,note_content summary,CONCAT(LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'),23),'+08:00') at FROM admin_case_note WHERE admin_case_id=#{id} AND note_type='contact_record' ORDER BY created_at DESC,id
SELECT FROM refund_order r WHERE r.biz_order_type='custom_order' AND r.biz_order_id=#{order} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.id

SELECT id,summary,evidence_json evidence,CONCAT(LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'),23),'+08:00') at FROM custom_after_sale_factory_statement WHERE after_sale_id=#{sale} ORDER BY created_at,id
mapper.update: UPDATE custom_after_sale_request SET version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{sale}
